document.about: International Journal for Equity in Health (2016) article, 'Socioeconomic Inequality in mortality using 12-year follow-up data from nationally representative surveys in South Korea', PMC4802872. Its Table 2 (p7) groups its rows under labels in the stub (`Education`, `Occupation`, `Monthly household income (USD)`), ruled only above and under its header, and runs on past the page's foot. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#350): the page's one ruled grid was the header band, alignment was preferred over it, and the text reading of that band alone was empty; alignment read the rows in pieces, broken at each group label, the RR columns of `Occupation` and below left as text. Such a seed is now read on below its last rule, and that reading, holding more of the table, stands. The spanning `Men 30 years of age and older` / `Women …` level of the header is still lost (#351).
2026-11-26: the document's title is a `doco:Title`, the document's header, apart from its sections, as a Word document's and a deck's are. The title's checks look for it there.
